title.h2: Full Stack Web Developer & Web Designer

about.label: About Me
about.heading: Full Stack Developer passionate about Frontend
about.p: I am a full stack developer with a focus on the front-end, a graduate of the Henry intensive bootcamp, and currently studying Computer Engineering. I have had the opportunity to work in eCommerce and food industries, where I worked with different technologies that I learned autonomously. I am passionate about everything related to interface and user experience, and I like to provide companies with scalable projects to generate customer engagement. Thanks to my experience I have developed skills such as creativity, problem-solving, and assertive communication that allow me to perform both in collaborative teams and individual projects.

projects.label: Featured projects
projects.piDescription: Henry Videogames is a web application that allows the user to visualize video games using the Rawg API, as well as their details (description, release date, genres, and platforms) and offers the possibility to add your own video games.
projects.foodifyDescription: Web application created to help restaurants to organize their tables, metrics, employees, and menu. I worked in the Frontend part of the team, where we used React.
projects.marketDescription: Online gamer technology store developed for Market on Demand S.A. Full e-commerce with product catalog, shopping cart, multiple payment methods, and nationwide shipping.
projects.vestaDescription: Online handcrafted ceramics store developed for Vesta Elemento. E-commerce featuring limited edition collections, stock management, and order processing.
projects.macasaDescription: Institutional website for MACASA Desarrollos, an Argentine industrialized housing company featuring the INBUILD system. Built with Next.js, showcasing housing models, construction technology, and a contact form.
